posts.text:
I’m going to make a bold prediction:

General Contractors that rely almost entirely on subs will fail within the next 10 years.

Not because of a lack of work, but because AI is going to make their middle man role obsolete.

AI will help small businesses handle all the legalese, paperwork, and project coordination that GCs used to manage. And buyers, whether they’re homeowners or developers, will be able to use AI to organize and manage projects directly.

Most (not all) GCs today are really just admin layers between the client and the people doing the work. Once AI can handle contracts, scheduling, compliance, and communication…what’s left?

They won’t vanish overnight, but over time, the companies that actually do the work will no longer need them.

The future belongs to the ones who build.
